github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write a single concise commit subject line in imperative mood, max 72 characters. Always start with a Conventional Commits type prefix followed by a colon and a space. Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert. Optionally add a scope in parentheses to indicate which part of this static site changed. Valid scopes: ui (index.html and style.css: markup, layout, styling), logic (script.js: calculations, persistence, copy summary), i18n (i18n.js: translations and language switch), docs (README and other documentation), config (.kiro, .vscode and other tooling files). When a single commit changes more than one area, join the scopes with a plus sign, e.g. feat(ui+logic):. Omit the scope when the change touches everything or does not fit a single area. Do not add a body, bullet points, or explanatory paragraphs. Do not add a Co-Authored-By footer or any trailer. Summarize only the essence of the change. Only add a short body if the change is genuinely complex and cannot be conveyed in the subject alone.
